description: Recent French insolvency-proceeding notices (familleavis="collective": redressement judiciaire, liquidation judiciaire, sauvegarde and their related deposit/judgment notices) published since a given date, newest first. Built for monitoring — poll with an advancing `since` to catch new insolvency events. Optionally narrow to a département. For a specific company's status use bodacc_company_events instead.

departement.description: French département code to filter on, e.g. "75" (Paris).

limit.description: Number of notices to return (1-100). Default 20.

offset.description: Result offset for pagination. Default 0. offset+limit is capped at 10,000 by the upstream API.

since.description: Only notices published on/after this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Required.

until.description: Only notices published on/before this date, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for open-ended (up to today).

name: bodacc_insolvency_feed
title: Bodacc Insolvency Feed
